column3: “Saying” is rendered “men”; NASB has “all the arrogant men.”
“Exile us” is rendered “exile us to Babylon.”
NASB puts “for they did not obey” in parentheses.
“The mortar” and “brick-terrace” are rare words; the meaning is uncertain.
“Beth Shemesh” is rendered “Heliopolis,” and “sacred pillars” as “obelisks.”
